verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth docs explicitly confirm password, magic link, OTP, social login, and SSO methods available via SDK, and community comments corroborate its RLS-based auth as a core differentiator adopted widely. Some early community comments note initial auth feature gaps (2020-era), but current docs clearly show comprehensive social OAuth and password support. Missing for 10: a concrete quickstart snippet showing SDK code for social OAuth sign-in, and independent hands-on validation of 'minutes' setup claim.
